Name: Anime Style Skimpy Portraits for Xtardew Valley
Author: RayY0un9
Description:
[b]If the original author requests, I will delete it immediately.[/b]

[b]Installation method: Overwrite the folder with the same name in the MODs folder.[/b]

If you find any BUG, please leave your comment.
Created Xtardew Valley portraits of characters like JODI, ROBIN, Caroline... in the style of TwoCircles, along with some corresponding sprite images, while also restoring related events such as Greenhouse, Leah x Abigail, Sophia x Penny... and adapting them to Anime Style Skimpy Portraits.
If you are a non-Chinese user, change the corresponding parts of the content.json file in [CP]Xtardew Portraits&Sprites to another language.
